errors.error_description: An input port 'start' is procedurally driven inside the module in the reset branch of an always_ff block.
Declared internal net 'phantom_gate' is never driven but is used to drive 'valid_o', creating an undriven internal connection.
A combinational always block reads 'enable' but the sensitivity list omits it, leading to a mismatch between read signals and the sensitivity list.
Assigns a 5-bit value 'code_wide' to a 4-bit register 'code_comb', causing truncation of the MSB.
